# Speedtest

> Speedtest is a comprehensive internet speed testing platform offering apps, diagnostics, and network monitoring tools across multiple devices and platforms.

Speedtest, owned by Ookla, provides free speed testing applications and services for measuring download/upload speeds, diagnosing network issues, and monitoring internet performance. The platform includes dedicated apps for mobile, desktop, and smart TV devices, alongside network monitoring and outage detection capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Internet speed testing
- Download/upload metrics
- Mobile apps (Android, iOS)
- Desktop applications (Windows, macOS)
- Network diagnostics
- Speed test results
- Cross-platform apps
- Apple TV
- CLI tools
- Speedtest VPN
- Video streaming quality
- Speedtest Maps
- Outage monitoring
- Ookla
- Downdetector

## Speedtest Apps & Downloads

- [Speedtest Apps: Our internet speed test available across a variety of platforms](https://www.speedtest.net/apps): Download Speedtest apps for Android, iOS, desktop and other platforms
- [Speedtest for Android: Mobile internet speed test app for Android](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/android): Free Speedtest app for Android with speed testing and network diagnostics
- [Speedtest for Apple TV: Internet speed test for Apple TV](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/appletv): Free Speedtest app for Apple TV to diagnose internet connection speed
